coffees.name: Latte
coffees.description: Espresso topped with a generous pour of steamed milk and a light layer of foam — smooth, mellow, and milk-forward.

coffees.name: Flat White
coffees.description: A flat white is an espresso-based coffee drink made with two shots of espresso (or ristretto) and steamed milk topped with a thin layer of velvety microfoam. Originating in Australia or New Zealand, it is served in a small cup (typically 5–6 ounces) and is characterized by a higher coffee-to-milk ratio than a latte, resulting in a stronger, more intense coffee flavor with a smooth, creamy texture

coffees.name: Cappuccino
coffees.description: Equal parts espresso, steamed milk, and airy microfoam — bold, frothy, and a classic.

coffees.name: Americano
coffees.description: Espresso diluted with hot water for a lighter body, with the same rich flavor as drip coffee.

coffees.name: Espresso
coffees.description: A concentrated shot of coffee brewed by forcing hot water through finely-ground beans — bold and intense.

coffees.name: Mocha
coffees.description: Espresso with steamed milk and chocolate syrup, topped with whipped cream — a sweet cross between a latte and hot cocoa.

coffees.name: Macchiato
coffees.description: Espresso 'stained' with just a dollop of foamed milk — strong coffee flavor with a touch of creaminess.

coffees.name: Cold Brew
coffees.description: Coffee steeped in cold water for 12+ hours, producing a smooth, low-acid, naturally sweet concentrate served over ice.

coffees.name: Affogato
coffees.description: A scoop of vanilla ice cream drowned in a shot of hot espresso — part dessert, part coffee.

coffees.name: Cortado
coffees.description: Espresso cut with a small amount of warm milk to reduce acidity while keeping a strong coffee flavor.

coffees.name: Black Coffee
coffees.description: Simple drip coffee, brewed hot and served plain — no milk, no sugar, just coffee.
